categories.main_business_segments: Yihai International Holding Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of hot pot condiments, compound condiments, and convenient ready-to-eat food products. The company serves both third-party customers and related parties such as Haidilao Group, Super Hi Group, and Shuhai Supply Chain Group. It also focuses on expanding its sales network domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates traditional brewing techniques with modern technology to develop its products. It emphasizes research and development through a project-based product system, leveraging market research, data analysis, and collaboration with external professional institutions. The company also invests in intelligent production and supply chain innovations to improve product quality, safety, and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yihai serves family cooking customers, catering service providers, food industry companies, and related party groups such as Haidilao, Super Hi, and Shuhai Supply Chain. Its products are distributed through third-party distributors, e-commerce platforms, and catering customers. The company targets both retail consumers and business-end customers with customized and standard products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across China covering 34 provincial and administrative regions, and exports to 49 overseas countries and regions. It has subsidiaries and sales operations in major markets including Singapore, the United States, Australia, Taiwan, Thailand, South Korea, Malaysia, the United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines. The company is expanding its overseas presence, including establishing supply centers in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yihai operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product research and development, manufacturing, and sales. It manages an integrated operation of production, sales, and research through independently operating factories for condiments, instant meals, and tallow. The company also optimizes its supply chain with a focus on intelligent production and overseas supply chain development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes enhancing its research and development capabilities by refining its project-based product system, increasing collaboration with external experts, and incorporating AI technology to improve research efficiency. It focuses on product diversification, regional customization, health, taste, cost-effectiveness, and expanding product matrices to meet evolving consumer demands. Overseas market adaptation and food safety standards are also key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Yihai generates revenue primarily through the wholesale and direct sale of its condiment and convenient food products to third-party distributors, e-commerce platforms, catering customers, and related parties. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery, with credit terms typically ranging from 30 to 90 days. The company also leverages online sales through flagship stores on major e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yihai is a leading compound condiment manufacturer in China and a major supplier to prominent hot pot restaurant chains such as Haidilao. It positions itself as a fast-growing player with a diversified product portfolio and strong channel management. The company competes by focusing on product innovation, channel expansion, and multi-brand strategies to build competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, Yihai reported revenue of RMB6,539.6 million, a 6.4% increase year-on-year, with net profit of RMB799.5 million, a decrease of 11.9%. Third-party sales revenue grew by 10.4%, with significant growth in e-commerce channels (30.9%). The company maintains a strong balance sheet with no bank borrowings, an asset-liability ratio of 18.4%, and cash and cash equivalents of approximately RMB1.88 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yihai emphasizes delivering high-quality, diversified, and customized condiment and convenient food products that cater to regional tastes, consumption habits, and channel characteristics. Its integration of traditional and modern production methods, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic partnerships with leading restaurant groups provide unique value. The company also focuses on product safety, innovation, and cost-effectiveness to differentiate itself in the market.
